name: Brevitus Technology
tagline: Building a modern web platform for courses, internships, and events
about: Brevitus Technology is a platform focused on digital solutions, courses, internships, and technical events. During my 3-month internship I contributed to building out the frontend of a modern, responsive web platform.

sections.heading: Context
sections.body: I joined Brevitus Technology as a Web Development Intern for three months, working on the frontend of a platform that aggregates courses, internship listings, and technical events for students and professionals.

sections.heading: My Role
sections.body: As a Web Development Intern, I contributed to building responsive UI components and interactive page sections. The work involved translating design requirements into functional Next.js components using TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, with Framer Motion for animations.

sections.heading: Frontend Architecture
sections.body: The platform is built with Next.js App Router for server-side rendering and file-based routing. TypeScript provides type safety across components and data flows. Tailwind CSS handles styling through utility classes, and Framer Motion provides smooth animations and transitions.

sections.heading: Responsive Design
sections.body: Components were built mobile-first, with Tailwind's responsive prefixes ensuring consistent layouts across phone, tablet, and desktop viewports. Careful attention was paid to touch targets and readable typography at all screen sizes.

sections.heading: Challenges & Learnings
sections.body: Working in a professional team codebase required understanding existing patterns and conventions before contributing. This internship strengthened my understanding of production-grade Next.js architecture, collaborative code practices, and building for real users rather than personal projects.
